title: Service area screening
actual_behavior_and_limit: Configured fictional postcode check works; changed exception locations can reuse old checked follow-up evidence. Actual coverage/capacity remains a client decision.
human_boundary: Confirm actual capacity and exceptional locations.
integration_requirement_from_source: Application service-area configuration; no ShiftCare write is required.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Approve the list and routing rules; retain uncertainty rather than rejecting negotiable areas.
acceptance_from_source: Covered, uncertain and unconfigured postcodes produce the correct recorded outcome.

title: Centralized enquiry collection
actual_behavior_and_limit: Hub captures/deduplicates an exact fictional source. Separate inbox tasks and shared collectors exist; the hub itself does not collect a live mailbox or synchronize those stores.
primary_steps: Capture one sample enquiry and link its sources
human_boundary: Log unsupported phone/voicemail sources and resolve uncertain identities.
integration_requirement_from_source: Existing intake API and Microsoft Graph folder delta; ShiftCare client search supplies optional matches.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Test actual mailbox notifications, expired cursors, folder scope, attachments and source replay.
acceptance_from_source: Repeated or changed sources create the correct case/version without duplicate enquiries.

title: Enquiry ownership and prioritization
actual_behavior_and_limit: Owner/deadline and queue are represented. Follow-up responsibility freezes after the first saved effect; automatic escalation policy is not demonstrated by the hub.
primary_steps: Record the sample assignment and deadline
mandatory_outcomes: Record the callback outcome
human_boundary: Confirm urgency, sensitive routing and candidate invoice/booking identity.
integration_requirement_from_source: Application cases; ShiftCare clients/shifts/invoices for record context where needed.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add approved assignment/escalation rules and notification outcomes; current classification is a suggestion.
acceptance_from_source: Each request has one accountable next action; missed deadlines remain visible and owned.

title: Missing information detection
actual_behavior_and_limit: Required-field blocking works in the hub; separate intake PDF/OCR, missing-contact and human-review checks passed. Required rules still need client approval.
human_boundary: Resolve ambiguous dates, verify authenticity and provide missing answers.
integration_requirement_from_source: Application forms and local extraction; no native mutation is needed for the checks.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Approve required fields and test representative forms. F applies to checking, not obtaining truthful answers.
acceptance_from_source: Incomplete, unsupported and ambiguous sources are flagged without invented values.

title: Participant onboarding and profile updates
actual_behavior_and_limit: Reviewed onboarding, demo read-back and required agreement/billing evidence are represented. The simulated profile does not populate the older participant dataset or prove a native/Xero write.
primary_steps: Save the approved sample participant fields
mandatory_outcomes: Verify agreement and required documents | Record the billing-readiness handoff
human_boundary: Approve identity, consent, field values and separate service/accounting readiness.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare GET clients/client; POST or PUT clients using an explicit whitelist.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Validate native intake feature fit, actual forms, mapped fields and account writes; preserve prospects until activation is approved.
acceptance_from_source: The source and exact approved fields link to one verified native identity; replay creates no duplicate.

title: Worker onboarding coordination
actual_behavior_and_limit: Reviewed worker proposal plus screening, agreement and payroll handoffs are represented. Staff judgment and payroll authority remain manual/native; no new HR system is implied.
primary_steps: Save approved sample staff fields
mandatory_outcomes: HR confirms screening and qualification checks | Verify access and invitation outcome | Record the payroll setup handoff
human_boundary: HR verifies qualifications, employment decisions and payroll readiness.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare GET staff/qualifications; POST or PUT staff. Existing payroll setup stays separate.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Test role/invitation behaviour and readiness checks. A recorded onboarding status does not itself establish sign-in permissions.
acceptance_from_source: Approved basic staff data is verified and incomplete HR/payroll steps prevent readiness claims.

title: Client stages and agreed service details
actual_behavior_and_limit: Stage/agreed-hours proposal and checked follow-through are represented; accepted account fields, versions and write support remain gated.
primary_steps: Apply the approved sample stage transition
mandatory_outcomes: Confirm any required service and billing handoffs
human_boundary: Approve activation, service hours, funding implications and effective dates.
integration_requirement_from_source: Published clients PUT includes client_status; agreed hours also need native service/fund evidence and booking links.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Extend the mapping whitelist for explicit stage transitions; define which native record owns agreed hours rather than creating a second editable agreement.
acceptance_from_source: Only an approved transition changes the native stage; hours retain their authoritative source.

title: Correspondence preparation
actual_behavior_and_limit: Prepared correspondence and required follow-through are represented; sending is not live in the hub and remaining follow-up cannot be reassigned after the seeded saved step.
primary_steps: Prepare the reviewed sample correspondence handoff
mandatory_outcomes: Record staff-checked message dispatch | Check the required communication outcome
human_boundary: Approve sensitive wording and send through the agreed channel.
integration_requirement_from_source: Application templates and existing ShiftCare communication UI; Graph sending would require separate Mail.Send permission and implementation.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Implement reusable templates and checks. Do not depend on an unverified ShiftCare SMS/chat send API.
acceptance_from_source: A complete reviewed message reaches an owned handoff; no task is labelled as a delivered message.

title: Communication tracking and history
actual_behavior_and_limit: Communication reference and checked outcome can be recorded. Mailbox dispatch/delivery/thread evidence is not generated by the hub; retain the gate.
primary_steps: Link the sample channel evidence
mandatory_outcomes: Record the required response or owned next action
human_boundary: Resolve unsupported channels and verify actual acknowledgement when required.
integration_requirement_from_source: Graph Inbox/Sent Items and authorized native references; ShiftCare shift events may corroborate specific service communications.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Agree channel coverage and add permitted Sent Items/failure evidence. A Graph 202 response is not delivery proof; universal cross-channel read receipts are not promised.
acceptance_from_source: Each status is backed by its own evidence, with unknown outcomes and failed delivery kept open.

title: Booking preparation and availability checks
actual_behavior_and_limit: Reviewed booking fields and required acceptance/participant outcomes are represented; live availability and native concurrency are not validated. The booking-only browser profile is a dropdown smoke check.
primary_steps: Create the approved sample one-off booking
mandatory_outcomes: Check native worker acceptance | Confirm the participant’s arrangement
human_boundary: Confirm suitability, worker willingness, participant agreement and native acceptance.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare shifts/staff/leaves/qualifications; published availability_schedules and POST shifts can extend the adapter.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add a whitelisted one-off create adapter and explicit native IDs/defaults if API creation is included. Availability patterns need date expansion; free time is not willingness.
acceptance_from_source: A reviewed one-off arrangement has a verified native result or an explicit native creation handoff.

title: Booking change scope and verification
actual_behavior_and_limit: Exact-occurrence proposal, stale-approval invalidation and saved-result checks work on fictional cases. Native recurrence boundaries still require accepted integration trials.
primary_steps: Update only the approved sample occurrence
mandatory_outcomes: Confirm the changed arrangement with the participant | Check worker acceptance of the change
human_boundary: Approve occurrence/series scope and resolve group or locked bookings.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare GET/PUT shifts; published recurrence/shifts and recurrence/pattern operations need separately scoped adapters.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Keep initial writes to accepted occurrence scope. Series operations are published but not implemented in the existing adapter.
acceptance_from_source: Only the approved scope changes; native mismatch, stale data and locks leave an owned exception.

title: Travel checking and stale value detection
actual_behavior_and_limit: Hub fingerprints sample inputs without calculating kilometres. The separate travel checker passed change/review/persistence tests; live route accuracy was not tested.
human_boundary: Verify ambiguous addresses and approve actual claims or scheduling decisions.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare roster/address reads plus existing Mapbox routing; no automatic km/pay write is required.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Move dependency fingerprints/checks to shared server records. F covers estimates and stale-value checks, not mileage entitlement.
acceptance_from_source: Changes to worker, address or preceding visit invalidate the estimate; no estimate becomes actual mileage.

title: Shift instruction maintenance
actual_behavior_and_limit: Reviewed instruction version/occurrence scope and a required outcome are represented; actual supported-field writes and exclusion rules remain gated.
primary_steps: Apply the approved sample instructions
mandatory_outcomes: Check the affected visits against the approved version
human_boundary: Approve wording, effective date and affected occurrences.
integration_requirement_from_source: Published ShiftCare PUT shifts accepts description; recurrence/shifts also documents description.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add a description-only adapter, version/hash checks and read-back. Validate series behaviour and locked/cancelled records before bulk changes.
acceptance_from_source: Selected editable bookings match the approved instructions without changing unrelated fields.

title: Participant confirmation monitoring
actual_behavior_and_limit: Clear-confirmation sample path works. A clear cancel response can complete as a confirmation without creating/linking cancellation handling; backend reviewed W06 branching exists separately.
primary_steps: Record the matched sample confirmation
human_boundary: Resolve sender/occurrence ambiguity and approve any resulting service mutation.
integration_requirement_from_source: Native reminders send SMS replies to admin email; Graph collects them. GET shift events provides an additional documented source.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Test actual notification formats, mailbox routing, quoted replies and occurrence matching; add event reads if needed.
acceptance_from_source: A clear reply routes once; ambiguous replies and silence never trigger automatic cancellation.

title: Complete cancellation handling
actual_behavior_and_limit: Hub and older cancellation assistant exercise cleanup, partial failure/recovery and required communications. Shared W07 still completes before W13 follow-up and lacks travel cleanup; do not claim surface parity.
primary_steps: Check and clear required sample travel values | Cancel the approved sample occurrence
mandatory_outcomes: Verify the required financial treatment | Check the participant update outcome | Check the assigned worker update outcome
human_boundary: Approve cause, notice, actual travel and financial treatment; review locked or unsupported changes.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare shift reads/updates/cancel plus invoice/timesheet or invoiceable evidence; native communication handoff.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add verified cleanup before cancellation where required. Cancelled shifts restrict later edits. Model cleanup-success/cancel-failure and block closure until required handoffs finish.
acceptance_from_source: No untravelled charge remains incorrectly applied; partial or unknown outcomes stay open without duplicate dispatch.

title: Absence and replacement cover coordination
actual_behavior_and_limit: Candidate, acceptance and participant outcomes are represented; actual worker suitability/acceptance and native offers remain human/native. Shared aggregate completion is incomplete.
primary_steps: Save the accepted sample replacement assignment
mandatory_outcomes: Confirm participant preference and arrangement | Check required worker and office updates
human_boundary: Choose suitable cover and confirm worker acceptance and participant preference.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare shifts/staff/leaves/qualifications; native job board/offers. Published job_board_postings is a possible later adapter.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add shared cover-case dependencies and affected-service tracking. Keep offer and acceptance native until their adapters are accepted.
acceptance_from_source: Each affected service has a verified arrangement or owned no-cover outcome, with required communication.

title: Factual absence histories
actual_behavior_and_limit: Factual history/reference can be staff checked. Dedicated absence-history automation remains deferred; do not turn a demonstration receipt into a staff-performance conclusion.
primary_steps: Retain the staff-checked native history reference
human_boundary: Management resolves disputed facts and all employment interpretation.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare roster/leave/events plus approved staff-logged communication references.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Defer dedicated HR history until core absence coordination is accepted; define restricted access and corrections.
acceptance_from_source: A source-linked history is visible only to authorized reviewers; it makes no performance conclusion.

title: Document matching and filing
actual_behavior_and_limit: Correct-person filing proposal, demo read-back and required outcome are represented. Separate shared intake retains private originals; hub save is not an actual ShiftCare attachment.
primary_steps: File the approved sample original
mandatory_outcomes: Independently check the native filing result
human_boundary: Confirm person, signature/version, category and permitted visibility.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare client documents/type/download APIs; approved download hosts. Staff filing stays an explicit handoff initially.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Validate actual document types, field/date formats and download hosts. Do not claim the adapter supports every staff file or image.
acceptance_from_source: The correct original is verified under the correct native person, category and access setting.

title: Document completeness and attachment checks
actual_behavior_and_limit: Configured sample metadata scope blocks incomplete/unknown completeness checks. Presence does not establish authenticity, signature validity or document meaning.
human_boundary: Assess signature, authenticity and documents held outside the visible sources.
integration_requirement_from_source: Graph attachments; ShiftCare client documents, staff_files and qualifications; approved requirement rules.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add requirement matrices and complete-scope results. F covers presence/metadata checks, not proof that a valid agreement exists or is absent everywhere.
acceptance_from_source: Missing, present and unreadable/unknown evidence remain distinct and generate the right follow-up.

title: Document date and expiry correction
actual_behavior_and_limit: Reviewed expiry/date proposal and checked outcome are represented; account field clearing, permissions and genuine expiry semantics remain gated.
primary_steps: Apply the approved sample metadata correction
mandatory_outcomes: Recheck the corrected date and genuine renewal status
human_boundary: Interpret document meaning and approve non-expiring classifications.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare client document PUT and staff_qualifications PATCH; general staff-file edits need a supported method or native handoff.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Validate date/null/no-expiration response semantics. General staff-file expiry correction is not implemented in the current adapter.
acceptance_from_source: Only evidence-backed corrections suppress false alerts; genuine expiries remain visible.

title: Renewal and coordinator follow up
actual_behavior_and_limit: Owned renewal/coordinator follow-up and receipt are represented. Hub does not autonomously send/chase; native reminder reuse, missed-run recovery and escalation remain implementation tasks.
primary_steps: Create one owned sample renewal follow-up
mandatory_outcomes: Verify the received original and filing result
human_boundary: Verify received documents, funding/date meaning and completion.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare documents/qualifications/fund context and native expiry reminders; application schedules/Graph responses.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Reuse native reminder sending, repair metadata first, avoid duplicate alerts and implement missed-run recovery and escalation.
acceptance_from_source: A due item creates one owned follow-up, remains open until checked and survives a missed schedule.

title: Invoice preparation checks
actual_behavior_and_limit: Fictional invoice-preparation case and separate period-based financial findings work. Missing evidence, source-change reopening and checked resolution passed; no native invoice release was certified.
primary_steps: Prepare the sample invoice exception list
mandatory_outcomes: Record the bookkeeper’s reviewed native export handoff
human_boundary: Bookkeeper approves category, charge, tax and unusual treatment, then uses native export.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare shifts/timesheets/progress_notes/invoices and published invoiceable_items; existing ShiftCare-Xero integration.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add cursor-aware pre-invoice reads and agreed rules/cutoffs. Use native pricing rather than calculating care billing rates in the application.
acceptance_from_source: Complete period evidence produces traceable exceptions; no duplicate invoice/export or false all-clear occurs.

title: Special billing instructions and prepayments
actual_behavior_and_limit: Reviewed billing/prepayment instructions are a staff-checked handoff; ledger allocation and accounting rule automation remain deferred.
primary_steps: Record the staff-checked accounting handoff
human_boundary: Bookkeeper applies balances and approves accounting treatment.
integration_requirement_from_source: Xero OAuth and read permissions for accounting evidence, linked by organization/ContactID; native references in ShiftCare.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Defer live balance integration until authorized Xero access and ID reconciliation are implemented. Do not create another ledger.
acceptance_from_source: Current accounting evidence is linked without automatic credit allocation or balance invention.

title: Billing recipient verification
actual_behavior_and_limit: Billing recipient verification is represented by a staff check; do not claim authoritative payer reconciliation or native master-data synchronization.
primary_steps: Retain the verified native billing recipient reference
human_boundary: Staff verify authority and effective payer changes before updating billing.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare client/contact/invoice context; Xero contacts for full cross-system comparison.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Defer dedicated cross-system recipient automation; keep checks in existing onboarding/billing review until account mappings are verified.
acceptance_from_source: A changed billing recipient has an authorized, effective instruction and verified native identity.

title: Returned invoice resolution
actual_behavior_and_limit: A returned-invoice case with follow-up is represented; separate financial checks exercise tracked payment/returned states. Native correction/resubmission remains a handoff.
primary_steps: Record the checked native correction outcome
mandatory_outcomes: Check the required invoice correspondence
human_boundary: Bookkeeper determines credit, correction or reissue and checks the result.
integration_requirement_from_source: Graph/staff-logged rejection evidence and ShiftCare/Xero invoice IDs; rejection reason is not guaranteed by invoice status alone.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Defer a dedicated correction/reissue automation; reuse #3/#22 cases and native accounting actions first.
acceptance_from_source: The reason and corrected native outcome are linked without a duplicate invoice.

title: Payment follow up
actual_behavior_and_limit: Owned payment chasing/checks are represented, with manually tracked evidence in the financial screen; no live debtor ledger or automatic cash reconciliation.
primary_steps: Record the reviewed native payment follow-up
mandatory_outcomes: Check the required payer-contact outcome
human_boundary: Bookkeeper approves disputes, escalation and any collection action.
integration_requirement_from_source: Xero invoice/payment status via new OAuth adapter; native ShiftCare due reminders where suitable.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Defer custom collection status until ledger IDs, tokens and reconciliation are accepted; do not treat a ShiftCare balance as verified Xero payment.
acceptance_from_source: Paid invoices stop further chasing and ambiguous/reversed payment states stay reviewable.

title: Pay period and employee checks
actual_behavior_and_limit: Pay-period/employee checks have a staff-checked handoff; actual payroll calendar, employee classifications and system authority remain to confirm.
primary_steps: Retain the payroll reviewer’s checked source reference
human_boundary: Payroll confirms final-pay eligibility and the meaning of prior values.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare staff/payroll fields plus the confirmed payroll platform API or approved export.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Defer payroll-side automation until the actual vendor/field mappings are known. Inactive ShiftCare access does not establish zero pay.
acceptance_from_source: Run dates/population reconcile and leavers needing final pay are retained.

title: Timesheet hours and mileage reconciliation
actual_behavior_and_limit: Hours/mileage review is represented. Separate payroll preparation passed actual-hours/mileage, draft export and stale-source blocking checks with fictional records.
primary_steps: Prepare the reviewed sample source-check handoff
mandatory_outcomes: Payroll reviewer checks native input and unresolved discrepancies
human_boundary: Payroll approves payable values and resolves discrepancies before native release.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare timesheets/shifts/pay-item evidence; existing timesheet export and a confirmed payroll API/export for two-sided reconciliation.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: First deliver source checks and reviewed handoff. Add two-sided comparison only against the real export/API; do not claim automated payroll reconciliation without it.
acceptance_from_source: Missing timesheets never become zero pay; approved quantities and units trace to their source and period.

title: Payroll adjustment tracking
actual_behavior_and_limit: Staff-checked adjustment handoff plus dated local adjustment/draft handling exist; this does not implement native payroll amendment/release.
primary_steps: Record the reviewed native adjustment outcome
human_boundary: Payroll calculates and approves leave, back pay and travel treatment in the established payroll process.
integration_requirement_from_source: Approved payroll export/API, leave evidence and restricted application adjustment records.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Keep calculations and native entry manual initially; support evidence through #28 rather than building an award/payroll engine.
acceptance_from_source: Each applied adjustment has the correct period, authorization and verified native result.

title: Payroll completion handoffs
actual_behavior_and_limit: Explicit reference and checked payroll handoff work; completion does not prove payslip distribution, accounting posting or money movement.
primary_steps: Record the native payroll handoff reference
human_boundary: Authorized payroll staff finalize the run, release payment and deliver payslips in the payroll platform.
integration_requirement_from_source: Existing payroll process and native integration; no custom release connector is required.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Retain finalization and money movement in the established platform; a duplicate release workflow adds little benefit and substantial risk.
acceptance_from_source: Preparation is handed off with evidence; payroll completion retains its own native approval trail.

title: Visit record and care exceptions
actual_behavior_and_limit: Factual care/visit exception and required follow-through are represented. Clinical judgments, factual verification and sensitive escalation remain with authorized staff.
primary_steps: Create the owned sample factual exception
mandatory_outcomes: Supervisor checks the native record and records the outcome
human_boundary: Supervisors investigate quality, care and employment concerns.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare shifts/timesheets/progress_notes; care_plan_tasks reads can add validated task context.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Validate complete periods, staff-specific evidence and restricted access; task-specific completion comparisons need accepted source fields.
acceptance_from_source: A factual exception cites its original record and owner without making a clinical or misconduct conclusion.

title: Feedback complaint and safety follow through
actual_behavior_and_limit: Feedback callback/corrective-action outcomes are represented. Supplemental reviews UI replay passed after an obsolete locator correction; fictional ratings are not complaint-resolution automation.
primary_steps: Record the restricted sample follow-up ownership
mandatory_outcomes: Supervisor records the reviewed callback outcome | Check the required corrective follow-through
human_boundary: Managers handle safety, complaint outcomes and personnel decisions; urgent procedures remain active.
integration_requirement_from_source: Staff-logged sources, Graph evidence and native record references; no automatic incident/complaint write is assumed.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add restricted case fields, owners, follow-up schedule and explicit urgent escalation; avoid automatic clinical triage.
acceptance_from_source: Every response/action has an accountable outcome; restricted information stays within permitted access.

title: Task completion handovers and escalation
actual_behavior_and_limit: Counts unfinished required outcomes and blocks many incomplete hub closures. No hub deadline/escalation scheduler is shown; assignment freezing and shared parent completion undermine full handover goals.
human_boundary: People perform tasks and management supplies delegated authority and actual coverage.
integration_requirement_from_source: Shared application cases/actions/outbox; optional approved native action-item references.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Add parent-case dependencies, external notification outcomes and catch-up. Current native jobs can complete before their separate communication follow-up.
acceptance_from_source: A parent case cannot close while any mandatory child outcome remains incomplete or uncertain.

title: Operational outcome reporting
actual_behavior_and_limit: Hub counters and CSV/history are available. Outcome/benefit reporting remains deferred; current sample counts do not establish time saved or operational performance.
primary_steps: Record the reviewed reporting handoff
human_boundary: Management interprets staffing, cost and demand implications.
integration_requirement_from_source: Read-only application/ShiftCare aggregates; use native financial reports unless ledger access is accepted.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Keep baseline pilot measures in core instrumentation; defer a dedicated reporting workflow until daily work is stable. No forecast model is proposed.
acceptance_from_source: Reports state period, source completeness and actual outcomes; they make no unsupported savings or revenue claim.

title: Arrival visibility if the remaining gap is confirmed
actual_behavior_and_limit: Staff-checked arrival/native handoff is represented. Device GPS, privacy/lifecycle and live ETA integrations were not validated; confirm a remaining native capability gap first.
primary_steps: Record the optional-feature review handoff
human_boundary: Approve access/consent and validate actual devices and withdrawal behaviour.
integration_requirement_from_source: ShiftCare current roster plus verified service identities, browser location and routing provider.
remaining_work_or_gate_from_source: Defer optional arrival work pending native-feature fit and device/privacy trials; continuous background tracking is not established.
acceptance_from_source: Only permitted current service access sees fresh status; reassignment or stale updates withdraw it.
